baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍ / أَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍ
baseline_models.mechanism: The matched causatives and cognate nouns make ingress and egress one two-sided process; repeated sidq requires both crossings, not merely the destination, to be sound and fully realized.

activation_trace.role: Ingress into an interior supplies the first threshold crossing and its manner.
Emergence from a place or state supplies the reciprocal threshold crossing.
Complete soundness and stability qualify both sides, making integrity symmetrical.

changed_reading.before: A generic request for a good entrance and exit.
changed_reading.after: A request that the whole passage across both boundaries, including manner and result, possess stable and complete integrity.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَٰنًا نَّصِيرًا
baseline_models.mechanism: Ja'l as placing into a condition joins sultan's compelling proof to nasr's active aid; the requested gift is evidence with operative backing, not bare force.

activation_trace.role: Making something assume a condition frames the authority as a bestowed functional capacity.
A compelling proof supplies the authority's evidentiary force.
Aid that brings one to visibility or advantage makes that proof actively supportive.

changed_reading.before: A request for power and a helper.
changed_reading.after: A request for a divinely bestowed warrant whose proof itself assists and vindicates the speaker.

baseline_models.mechanism: The command to externalize the prayer and the address to the Lord as owner and gradual former place every requested transition under spoken dependence and formation.

activation_trace.role: Audible production makes dependence an enacted utterance rather than an unspoken wish.
Lordship, ownership, and command identify the one from whom the requested direction comes.
Gradual repair and completion make the transitions formative, not merely relocative.

changed_reading.before: A private wish for favorable circumstances.
changed_reading.after: A mandated utterance of dependence in which the speaker asks to be formed through every transition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The timed prayer sequence and the promised maqam recast ingress and egress as faithful handoffs among recurring stations, with truthful movement tending toward stable standing.

activation_trace.role: Ingress anchors the reading in the focus ayah's first transition.
Egress anchors the reciprocal handoff.
Rising with resolve to an affair turns the ordered prayer into active station-taking.
A station and abiding place supply the stable terminus toward which the handoffs tend.
Dawn breaking from night marks a recurrent temporal threshold.

structural_cues: 17:78 distributes prayer across solar decline, night, and dawn.
17:79 adds night vigil and a praised station.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies timed thresholds and a praised maqam; I infer that the paired ingress and egress ask for faithful passage among them. A concrete or social relocation remains live.

changed_reading.before: Sound passage into and out of an unspecified situation.
changed_reading.after: Truthful handoffs through recurring worship times, culminating in a stable praiseworthy station.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next proclamation supplies directional content for the focus pair: what enters is reality with staying force, while what exits is unreality whose trace is cut off.

activation_trace.role: Ingress provides the receiving threshold for the arriving truth.
Egress provides the expelling threshold for falsehood.
Stable completeness makes the transition's criterion more than verbal honesty.
Reality fixed against falsehood supplies the durable content admitted.
Departure until no trace remains gives egress its eliminative direction.
Loss of truth and stability identifies what cannot retain occupancy.

structural_cues: 17:81 orders arrival before disappearance and repeats that falsehood is intrinsically vanishing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies truth's coming and falsehood's disappearance; I map that sequence onto the focus ayah's paired thresholds. The alternative is that 17:80 concerns personal relocation without specifying their contents.

changed_reading.before: The speaker seeks integrity while moving between situations.
changed_reading.after: The speaker asks to become a truthful threshold through which reality gains occupancy and falsehood loses it.

context_deltas.mechanism: What descends is delivered as cure yet produces opposite effects by reception; this revises sultan nasir into supporting proof whose force heals the receptive and exposes loss in the resistant.

activation_trace.role: Compelling evidence anchors sultan as proof rather than coercive office.
Aid and manifestation make the proof beneficially operative.
Delivery from above supplies a concrete mode by which the supporting proof arrives.
Healing and restoration specify the proof's supportive effect for receptive hearers.
Increase marks that the same disclosure intensifies an existing orientation.
General diminution supplies the resistant reception's contrary result.

structural_cues: 17:82 predicates healing and mercy for believers but only increased loss for wrongdoers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one descended discourse with bifurcating effects; I infer that it instantiates the focus ayah's supporting sultan. The live alternative is an external protector unrelated to the Qur'an.

changed_reading.before: A uniformly effective authority that protects its holder.
changed_reading.after: A delivered evidentiary authority whose aid is medicinal for receptivity but whose disclosure can deepen resistant loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opposed reactions to benefit and harm turn truthful entry and exit into affective discipline: neither receiving ease nor being touched by adversity should break congruence.

activation_trace.role: Stable completeness supplies the invariant required across changing states.
Ingress anchors reception of a new condition.
Egress anchors passage from or through that condition.
Good condition and benefit provide the favorable transition under test.
Turning one's side away supplies the failure mode during ease.
Distance intensifies withdrawal from the giver of the favorable state.
Severed hope supplies the opposite failure mode during adversity.

structural_cues: 17:83 balances two repeated conditional openings: benefit leads to withdrawal, while harm leads to despair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies affective reversals under changed conditions; I treat them as tests of the focus ayah's symmetrical sidq. They may instead be a separate anthropology of ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: Truthfulness concerns the objective quality of entry and exit.
changed_reading.after: Truthfulness also names continuity of orientation when entering ease and exiting or enduring distress.

context_deltas.mechanism: Action issues from a governing pattern and travels a path; the focus prayer can therefore seek truthful transitions at the level where disposition becomes action, not only at external doors.

activation_trace.role: Interior and hidden disposition supply the inward side of the focus threshold.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies action's emergence from inward pattern.
Fulfillment in action makes congruence between pattern and deed the test of truth.
Purposive action identifies what emerges from the inward pattern.
A governing way and orientation supply the action-producing configuration.
Gentle direction toward the true way supplies the desired calibration.
An extended traversable path gives the calibrated pattern a course.

structural_cues: 17:84 links each person's action to a shakila, then compares who is better guided in path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an action-producing pattern and a guided path; I infer an inside-to-outside arrow that the focus ayah asks to keep truthful. The verse can also be read only as external movement.

changed_reading.before: The prayer governs transitions between external situations.
changed_reading.after: The prayer also governs the passage by which inward configuration becomes outward action along a path.

context_deltas.mechanism: Divine provenance, limited human knowledge, possible removal, lack of a substitute guardian, and restoration by mercy recast sultan nasir as a delegated and revocable trust rather than owned mastery.

activation_trace.role: Granted capacity and office anchor the focus authority as delegation.
Aid makes the delegated capacity dependent on continuing support.
Authority and its holder sharpen the provenance of the adjacent divine command.
Disclosure to the knower frames knowledge as received access.
Paucity limits any claim that the granted authority is exhaustive mastery.
Taking away and departure make the revelatory endowment explicitly revocable.
A guardian who suffices in an affair supplies the absent replacement after removal.
Merciful tenderness identifies preservation as gift rather than entitlement.
Bestowed favor names the excess generosity sustaining the trust.

structural_cues: 17:85 places the spirit under divine command and human knowledge under scarcity.
17:86 imagines removal of revelation with no guardian recoverable against God; 17:87 excepts mercy and great favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies received knowledge, possible removal, no substitute, and merciful preservation; I infer that min ladunka similarly marks sultan as delegated and revocable. The alternative is that only revelation, not authority, is at issue.

changed_reading.before: The speaker asks to possess enough authority to prevail.
changed_reading.after: The speaker asks to be entrusted with a capacity that remains God's gift, bounded in knowledge and sustained only by mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The discourse cannot be reproduced even by pooled backing, yet its many reformulations do not force assent; sultan is therefore overwhelming in evidentiary standing without becoming coercive control.

activation_trace.role: Compelling proof anchors authority in evidentiary force.
Aid and manifestation distinguish support from forced compliance.
Combining the dispersed supplies the maximal coalition assembled for imitation.
Likeness supplies the attempted equivalence that the coalition cannot produce.
Taking strength from a backing helper directly contrasts pooled support with the focus's nasir.
Turning material through many forms supplies repeated evidentiary presentation.
Refusal shows that unmatched evidence does not mechanically compel reception.
Concealment of truth names the resistant response that remains possible.

structural_cues: 17:88 denies successful imitation even with universal mutual backing.
17:89 follows abundant variation of examples with majority refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-imitability, pooled helpers, varied presentation, and refusal; I infer a distinction between proof that prevails as proof and power that compels assent. The immediate claims still concern the Qur'an and its audience.

changed_reading.before: Supporting authority is power strong enough to defeat opposition.
changed_reading.after: Supporting authority is proof no coalition can equal, while leaving opponents capable of refusal and concealment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The escalating demand for material and vertical spectacle is answered by human messengerhood; this weakens the coercive-sultan baseline and strengthens authority as truthful warrant fitted to embodied mission.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering force is the focus branch tested and weakened by the demand sequence.
Compelling proof remains viable when spectacular domination is refused.
Water springing from the ground begins the demand that authority prove itself through material spectacle.
Gold supplies the demand that authority display itself as material splendor.
Ascent by stages supplies the demanded vertical escape from ordinary human scale.
The visibly embodied human supplies the response's accepted scale.
Messenger and message identify the office that remains after spectacle is disclaimed.

structural_cues: 17:90-93 escalate from spring and garden to falling sky, divine or angelic encounter, gold house, ascent, and a readable book.
17:93 answers with transcendence and human messengerhood; 17:94-95 defend a messenger fitted to terrestrial inhabitants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies demands for spectacular control and a human-messenger response; I infer that the focus prayer seeks warrant for faithful mission rather than possession of those spectacles. A historical protective power remains possible.

changed_reading.before: Sultan nasir may mean visibly overpowering resources that silence opposition.
changed_reading.after: Its coercive-spectacular sense is weakened; the stronger reading is supporting proof adequate to a truthful human mission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing appeal converts supporting proof into a juridical-relational mechanism: God's sufficient, informed witness stands between parties and provides vindication without worldly domination.

activation_trace.role: Compelling evidence supplies the warrant later concentrated in witness.
Aid and manifestation let witness function as vindicating support.
Carrying an affair through to sufficiency makes no additional guarantor necessary.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies the proof's juridical form.
The relation standing between parties gives testimony its adjudicative location.
Knowledge of inward reality guarantees that the witness reaches hidden facts.
Seeing supplies direct perceptual oversight alongside inward knowledge.

structural_cues: 17:96 says God suffices as witness between speaker and audience, then grounds that sufficiency in knowing and seeing servants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sufficient witness and comprehensive awareness; I infer that such witness realizes the focus ayah's proof and aid by vindication. The requested sultan may still include other forms of protection.

changed_reading.before: The speaker needs an additional agent or institution to support the claim.
changed_reading.after: Divine witness itself can be the sufficient supporting proof between contested parties.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant mapping from focus ق و ل to mapped ق ل ل, not an ordinary derivation of qul. The mapping is packet-explicit and nearby qalilan activates the same inventory, so retain it only as a branch-mediated resonance, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قُلْ, heard through the packet's secondary mapped root while the prayer asks for bestowed support

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant image of carrying and rising lets the commanded utterance shoulder a task.
Explicit paucity activates the shared mapped inventory and keeps the burden-bearing speech epistemically modest.
Bestowed capacity supplies what enables modest speech to stand under its commission.

changed_reading.before: Qul simply introduces the prayer as speech.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the commanded speech rises to bear a commission precisely from acknowledged human paucity and delegated capacity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The hydraulic mechanism is cross-domain and does not make the focus words water terms. It remains anchored in lexical inside, outside, concealment, solidity, and the packet's nearby splitting and channels; downstream prose should label it a material analogy for controlled permeability.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled inside/outside pair qualified by صِدْق

activation_trace.role: Interpenetrating parts and what lies between them turn ingress into permeability across a joined boundary.
Extraction from concealment makes egress a controlled release of what was within.
Material solidity supplies the boundary's integrity while passage occurs.
Wide splitting and outflow activate the risk of an uncontrolled breach.
Opening and widening until flow becomes possible supplies a regulated outlet.
Gaps between things locate the channels through which flow traverses a boundary.

changed_reading.before: Entry and exit are movements of a person between places or states.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the prayer asks for a boundary that admits and releases rightly without losing its integrity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The rain branch is form-distant from the ordinary adjectival sense of nasiran, and the activating water scenes are demands voiced by opponents. It remains packet-anchored as an analogy of aid's life-giving mode; it should not be rendered as a prediction of a water miracle.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: نَّصِيرًا as the manner of the requested سُلْطَان

activation_trace.role: Rain as relief and irrigation recasts aid as enabling life and growth rather than overpowering an enemy.
Water springing from a source activates the image of support arriving as provision.
A garden enclosed by trees supplies the living field sustained by that provision.
A river cutting through earth gives the aid a distributive and sustaining course.

changed_reading.before: Nasir is an ally who defeats or restrains opponents.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, supporting authority can work like irrigating relief, making truthful passage viable by sustaining rather than coercing.

strongest_changes: The reciprocal threshold prayer becomes a mechanism for truth to gain occupancy while falsehood loses it.
Sultan nasir shifts from owned coercive power toward delivered, revocable, and actively supporting proof.
The proof is unmatchable yet noncoercive: pooled helpers cannot reproduce it, while hearers remain able to refuse.
Human messengerhood weakens spectacular sovereignty, and sufficient divine witness supplies a juridical form of support.
summary.what_was_special: The doubled ingress and egress morphology, repeated sidq, and the context's progression from timed stations through truth and falsehood, bifurcating revelation, limited and revocable gift, failed spectacle demands, and sufficient witness produced several coexisting mechanisms. Packet-retained split mapping and water branches also preserved contained readings a conservative synthesis would likely drop.
remaining_uncertainties: Ingress and egress may still refer to concrete relocation, ritual temporality, mission phases, affective changes, or inward-to-outward action.
Sultan may foreground proof, delegated capacity, external protection, or several of these without disambiguation.
The split-root, permeability, and irrigating-support outliers are branch-triggered resonances, not ordinary lexical claims.
